verdict.rationale: iTerm2 lets users define triggers: regex rules that fire actions automatically when matching text arrives, such as highlighting, running commands, sending notifications, setting marks or invoking Python scripts. Automatic profile switching adds rules keyed to hostname, user or directory, and the Python API can create custom triggers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of triggers working in practice, and documentation of event types beyond text matches and session context (e.g., arbitrary app or system events).
